description: Current outdoor-burning ban status for Harris County, TX (which includes Crosby) from the Texas A&M Forest Service. Countywide only — TFS has no sub-county resolution, so this is never a Crosby-specific status.
name: get_burn_ban

lastChecked.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last data refresh.

startDate.description: ISO date-time the current ban took effect, as reported by TFS; null when there is no active ban.

status.description: "Yes" = ban in effect, "No" = no active ban, null = status unavailable from the last check.

statusSince.description: When the CURRENT status was first observed. Equal to trackingSince means no change has ever been witnessed — it is when observation began, NOT a transition date.

trackingSince.description: The first observation ever recorded for this feed.

title: Burn ban status
